Class PWMTalonSRX

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorSafety
org.wpilib.hardware.motor.PWMMotorController
org.wpilib.drivers.motor.PWMTalonSRX
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, MotorController, TelemetryLoggable
public class PWMTalonSRX extends PWMMotorController
Cross the Road Electronics (CTRE) Talon SRX Motor Controller.

Note that the Talon SRX uses the following bounds for PWM values. These values should work reasonably well for most controllers, but if users experience issues such as asymmetric behavior around the deadband or inability to saturate the controller in either direction, calibration is recommended. The calibration procedure can be found in the Talon SRX User Manual available from Cross the Road Electronics (CTRE).

  • 2.004ms = full "forward"
  • 1.520ms = the "high end" of the deadband range
  • 1.500ms = center of the deadband range (off)
  • 1.480ms = the "low end" of the deadband range
  • 0.997ms = full "reverse"
